## Changes
- Track unseen completion, questions/permissions, failures and interruptions in background tmux tabs.
- Acknowledge attention when visiting a tab; leaving it does not re-alert until a new attention state.
- Use the tmux theme's red for the status glyph only, preserving tab names and backgrounds.

## Setup
Update your tmux status format and add the visit-counter hooks shown in the README to enable attention coloring. Existing installations using the old status format must update their tmux configuration.

## Verification
- All seven automated tests pass.
- Real tmux checks cover attention coloring, visit acknowledgement, new-state re-alerting and numeric counter boundaries.

Published on npm as `@ardnep/opencode-tmux-status@1.1.0`.

Full changes: https://github.com/ardnep/opencode-tmux-status/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0

Initial release of @ardnep/opencode-tmux-status.

- TUI plugin for OpenCode V2 with pane-level tmux status indicators.
- Working, waiting for input, retrying, done, failed, and stopped states.
- GPL-3.0-or-later license.
- Install through the plugins list in ~/.config/opencode/cli.json; see the README for tmux configuration.

Validation: five tests pass, and the packed TUI entrypoint was tested against an isolated tmux server using simulated session states. The OpenCode SDK dependency tree currently has 24 moderate npm audit advisories.
